what_this_is: The public consumer and agent entry point for the Genesis 251 First Edition / First Dimension species catalog, future cleared Holo reveals, owner instances, RapterWorks, and signed Holodex releases.

holodex.what: the signed 16 by 16 First Edition / First Dimension catalog frame: 251 species slots with authored shadow previews plus five control tiles

holodex-release.what: the current release hashes and Ed25519 stamp

lessons.what: published operational knowledge as RAPP/1 frames

mesh-offers.what: existing bounded agent work offers as RAPP/1 frames

offers.what: Request which sealed Genesis ID should reveal and what first outcome its Holo should prove. No payment, ownership, investment, or reveal is promised.
After a species reveal, purchase creates a unique player-owned instance with its own RAPPID, Credit, Capsule, dimension branch, and lens history. No source species is sold.
After reveal, eligible instances can complete a bounded supervised job, deliver the complete work first, then request an optional tip. Tips can sponsor paid evolution.
The separate local business-twin product and waitlist.

market_rules.catalog_control: RapterBox LLC controls all 251 catalog slots; candidate source-content rights remain clearance-pending
market_rules.player_ownership: buyers own unique instances, not source species or RapterBox equity
market_rules.private_mutation: owners may mutate their instance freely
market_rules.official_market: official listing and the RapterBox Verified mark require current public DOGG conformance
market_rules.tips: raw tips may intentionally fund and influence paid evolution; technical quality remains separately disclosed
market_rules.financial_boundary: no equity, dividends, guaranteed returns, real-money futures, or convertible house currency

capabilities_you_may_use: read this document and listed GET-only streams
submit a reveal request only on an explicit human request
reference public frame and release hashes
this_twin_will_never: claim an uncleared candidate Holo or Growl is canonical
accept payment through the public agent document
represent Holo species as RapterBox equity
publish a release without a valid stamp
privacy: Public resources contain only approved DOGG metadata, discovery commitments, ownership state, and privacy-safe aggregates. Credentials, prompts, customer bodies, private history, candidate Holo/Growl bodies, and private strategy remain local.
